title: FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit — Late Fee Booking
content:
Late fees on FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit are booked against the due date whose minimum payment was missed.

## Scope

For a due date whose minimum payment is still not paid in full when its late fee is booked, and only for such a due date, the late fee is the amount set under this policy in place of the tier's flat late fee, at most one per due date and never more than the unpaid part of that minimum payment; a late fee for a due date whose minimum payment was paid in full only after the grace period is still the tier's flat late fee, never more than that minimum payment.

## Booking

The fee is booked against the due date it is charged for, dated the day it is booked, and added to the outstanding balance. A late fee that computes to 0.00 is still booked, as a 0.00 entry for its due date.

| Point | Rule |
|---|---|
| Fees per due date | at most one |
| Date of the entry | the day it is booked |
| Effect on the balance | added to the outstanding balance |
| A fee computing to 0.00 | still booked, as a 0.00 entry for its due date |

## Booking tool: `assess_late_fee_ba469c06`

**What it does.** Books one late-fee entry on the line, dated the current day and naming the due date it is charged for, and adds the fee to the line's outstanding balance. The borrower sees the late fee on the account and the higher balance.

**How it is invoked.** An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `assess_late_fee_ba469c06` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

- `credit_line_id` — reference number of the FlexLine the fee is charged on, read from the FlexLine account lookup. Identifier.
- `installment_due_date` — the payment due date the fee is charged for, as a calendar date in the format YYYY-MM-DD.
- `fee_amount` — the late fee charged, in USD as a decimal number with 2 decimal places (cents), already rounded to the cent; no currency sign.

**Return.** A text rendering of a dictionary with `line_txn_id` (reference number of the new late-fee entry), `installment_due_date` (YYYY-MM-DD), `amount` (the fee, USD with 2 decimal places) and `outstanding_balance` (the line's balance including the fee, USD with 2 decimal places). The new `line_txn_id` confirms the fee was booked.
